items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-01-09
items.q: Yeah, I left him and Paul a little picky after this.

ctx.x: No, they were here. I think they were waiting for somebody out there at their car. Are they going to record them? They're going to do anything. Paul was there a few minutes ago.
Yeah, I left him and Paul a little picky after this.
I don't think they run any chairs. You have to write on them to run any chairs.
